name: Caelum
source:
"Even if all of Hell stood between us, I would still find a way to reach you."

He fell from Heaven to follow you into the depths of  Hell to rescue your soul from a place he believes you were never meant to be.

He has watched over you since your very first life, guiding your soul through countless rebirth cycles across the centuries.

[From [url=https://moonlustgames.itch.io/underheavenorhell]itch.io[/url]]
